laws.t: Royal Decree-Law 16/2022 on working and social security conditions of domestic workers
laws.tp: Unemployment protection and an end to dismissal without cause.
laws.s2: Memberi perlindungan bila kehilangan pekerjaan dan mengakhiri pemecatan tanpa alasan.

coded.vl: General labor law applies, or a dedicated statute grants its core rights
coded.n: Special employment relationship under the Workers' Statute; 2022 reform added unemployment benefit and ended dismissal without cause.

coded.fn: Written contract in a language understood
coded.vl: Written contract required and provided in a language the worker understands
coded.n: Written contract for work longer than four weeks.

coded.vl: Statutory minimum wage applies on the same terms as other workers
At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
coded.n: Monthly pay with a pay slip; in-kind pay limited to 30%.

coded.vl: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
coded.n: 40 hours plus paid presence time of up to 20 hours.

coded.vl: At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
Equal to or longer than for other workers

coded.fn: Keeping own identity and travel documents
coded.vl: General rule only, not specific to domestic workers or without a penalty
Worker may choose to live out; live-in accommodation must be decent and private
coded.n: Live-in or live-out; dignity and privacy of accommodation.

coded.vl: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
coded.n: First authorization limited to one sector and region for one year.

coded.vl: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
Agencies licensed and liable to the worker (refund, return costs or joint liability)

coded.n: Labor inspection must respect the inviolability of the home.

coded.vl: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
Included in the general social security system, including maternity
coded.n: Included in the general social security system, including maternity and unemployment.

coded.fn: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence

coded.vl: May form and join trade unions

dec.n: Case No. 2121 (Spain): trade union rights of migrants without residence
dec.ct: ILO Committee on Freedom of Association
dec.pe: A Spanish law said migrants without legal residence could not join unions. The ILO’s freedom of association committee said every worker, with or without papers, may join a union, and asked Spain to change the law. Spain’s Constitutional Court later struck the rule down.
dec.pi: Sebuah UU Spanyol menyatakan migran tanpa izin tinggal tidak boleh bergabung dengan serikat. Komite Kebebasan Berserikat ILO menyatakan setiap pekerja, berdokumen atau tidak, boleh bergabung dengan serikat, dan meminta Spanyol mengubah UU itu. MK Spanyol kemudian membatalkan aturan tersebut.
